about_short_description.short_description: Zeo Auto operates as fleet management and tracking software for commercial vehicles.

product.name: Zeo Route Planner
product.description: A route planning and optimization software that creates efficient delivery routes, tracks drivers in real-time, and manages last-mile delivery operations.

product.name: Zeo Mobile Route Planner App
product.description: A mobile application for drivers that provides navigation, route optimization, delivery updates, and communication tools.

product.name: Automated Delivery Updates
product.description: A system that automates real-time order tracking and sends instant delivery confirmations and notifications to customers.

product.name: Proof of Delivery Collection
product.description: A feature to capture digital proof of delivery through signatures or photographs to verify completed deliveries.

product.name: Parcel Management
product.description: A tool within the platform to manage and track parcels during the delivery process to ensure accurate and timely deliveries.

product.name: Route Analytics
product.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into delivery routes, driver performance, and operational efficiency to optimize logistics.
